name: glow-thinking
description: Status band above the prompt and gradient border around every side panel: WORKING (rainbow) while the turn or any subagent runs, WAITING (amber) for monitors and background tasks, IDLE (green) when done. /thinking shows time per model.

stopHooks.title: Stop hooks
stopHooks.description: on registers classic.Stop to list monitors, background tasks and schedules in WAITING. Set off on Claude Team or Enterprise logins, where the organization's guard skips those hooks and shows a notice: WAITING then shows background subagents only.
